'''Telega Lake''' was a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located on an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which had several spectacular waterfalls. Hidden behind the waterfalls was a series of caves used by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunner]] [[Nain Lup]]. Under the alias "Karbo Jaxx," he operated a [[Karbo's Gun Drop|drop point]] out of the caverns for [[Black market/Legends|black market]] deals with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="HS" />
